name: Dorrit
title: Keeper of the Painted Gull
examine: Flour to one elbow, brine to the other. She has never once let a story end badly inside her walls.
lines: Sit. Eat. The weather can wait, it always does.
The gull on my sign has one eye. Seff painted it. He says the other one watches the water.
You've the look of the road. The pot fixes that.
